incumbentTierChanges.name: Dani Alves
incumbentTierChanges.reason: Named in UEFA 2012-13 standout defenders; his high quality at right-back remained consistent after 2010-11 and 2011-12 Champions League performances.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Neven Subotić
incumbentTierChanges.reason: UEFA officially registered 99 balls recovered, second to Hummels. His personal defensive work, not club placing, supports A+.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Raphaël Varane
incumbentTierChanges.reason: UEFA registered 87 recovered balls, third in tournament, and he emerged as an excellent Madrid central defender; still limited prior UCL continuity.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Maxwell
incumbentTierChanges.reason: A very capable PSG left-back, but A+ imported from domestic form lacks sufficient personal 2010-11 to 2012-13 UCL evidence.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Javi Martínez
incumbentTierChanges.reason: Elite 2012-13 screening and ball-winning in Bayern's midfield; UEFA report confirms major individual role. Earlier two seasons at Athletic Bilbao lacked UCL appearances, so S-level three-season continuity is unproven.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Andrea Pirlo
incumbentTierChanges.reason: UEFA named Pirlo in outstanding 2012-13 midfield selection. Juventus had no Champions League participation in 2011-12; 2012-13 quality merits A+ without projecting three-season UCL S.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Arturo Vidal
incumbentTierChanges.reason: Elite Juventus dynamic midfield contribution in 2012-13, but absence of Juventus UCL in 2011-12 and limited comparative 2010-11 UCL evidence argue against S in this three-season context.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Andrés Iniesta
incumbentTierChanges.reason: UEFA 2012-13 selected Iniesta in midfield, following sustained top-end individual control and creativity in 2010-11 and 2011-12 UCL. S is based on European performance continuity rather than club progression.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Robin van Persie
incumbentTierChanges.reason: Outstanding league goalscoring alone is not S-level UCL evidence in 2012-13; meaningful prior Arsenal UCL attacking role weighted without overriding the more recent season.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Maicon
incumbentTierChanges.reason: Correctly identified FC Porto central defender Maicon Pereira Roque (1988-09-14); earlier C+ was undermined by possible same-name mismatch with FC Internazionale's Maicon (1981-07-26). His Porto UCL starting CB role warrants B+.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Thiago Silva

incumbentTierChanges.name: Franck Ribéry
incumbentTierChanges.reason: UEFA official five assists in 2012-13 and high-end winger creation, together with strong recent European contribution, support retaining S without counting the team title as an individual bonus.

incumbentTierChanges.name: Thomas Müller
incumbentTierChanges.reason: Eight UCL goals and UEFA technical attackers selection establish world-class individual season; retain A+ while distinguishing three-season top-tier continuity from permanent S.
